update: Author-authorized code licensing and proposed editorial verification
data_availability: Data Availability Statement: The two source corpora [12,13] have publisher pages listing CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Code S1 records attribution, access copies and license limits. Appendix A gives audited file digests. Tables S1–S9 and Code S1 provide aggregate findings and split summaries, excluding tweet text, account fields, row-level hashes and individual predictions. Full statistical reruns require the four lawful local inputs listed in the README. The author retains these inputs and is willing to arrange editorial verification under applicable source terms. The proposed procedure in docs/REVIEWER_ACCESS.md prioritizes source retrieval and digest matching, followed where necessary by restricted access agreed with the editor. No specific editorial channel has yet been agreed.
code_availability: Code Availability: Code S1 supplies statistical scripts, recovered airline split-generation code, aggregate audit inputs and revision sensitivities. The code and audit materials are publicly available at https://github.com/xiaobeiyi6-netizen/comparative-sentiment-validity (audited code commit 0e37fa4715f3). Eligible original code is licensed under MIT; LICENSE_SCOPE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md preserve third-party conditions. Full statistical reruns require the four individual inputs listed in the README. The separately supplied fixed-revision inference script reproduces the new run, rather than reconstructing historical neural inference. Code S1 also accompanies this revision. A release DOI has not been issued.

changes.before: Data Availability Statement: The third-party sources are Twitter US Airline Sentiment (CrowdFlower/Figure Eight; https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/crowdflower/twitter-airline-sentiment) and First GOP Debate Twitter Sentiment (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/crowdflower/first-gop-debate-twitter-sentiment; analyzed course-hosted copy: https://ptrckprry.com/course/ssd/data/GOP_REL_ONLY.csv). The publisher pages list CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; source terms and attribution are documented in Code S1. Appendix A gives the audited file digests. Tables S1–S8 and Code S1 provide aggregate findings and split summaries. Tweet text, account metadata, row-level text hashes and individual prediction exports are excluded from this distributable package. Full statistical reruns require the four lawful local inputs listed in the README; aggregate checks do not reconstruct individual annotations or historical neural inference. The author retains these inputs and is willing to arrange source-level editorial verification under applicable source terms. The proposed procedure in docs/REVIEWER_ACCESS.md prioritizes direct source retrieval and digest matching, followed where necessary by restricted access agreed with the editor. No specific editorial access channel has yet been agreed.
